result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers recommend headings plus whitespace and include sensible 'when to change' guidance. B gives a much fuller spacing system: label-to-field, heading-to-field, a 2:1 rule for space above versus below headings, and the advice to use container gap. It also explains why the clutter is lower and adds a practical squint test. A is solid and adds useful accessibility notes, but its spacing guidance is thinner. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers recommend headings plus whitespace. A gives more spacing detail: label-to-field, field-to-field, heading-to-field and section gaps, plus the 2:1 rule for space above versus below a heading. It also explains more clearly why each alternative adds clutter. B adds useful accessibility advice and good cases for switching methods, but its spacing guidance is thinner and it leaves out the heading-to-field gap.
